```lean
theorem lg_target {X : Type u} {κ : Cardinal.{u}} (hX : HasCardinalLT X κ) [Fact κ.IsRegular] : CategoryTheory.IsCardinalPresentable X κ := by
  apply CategoryTheory.IsCardinalPresentable.of_surjection
  use Function.surj_of_cardinal_le
  exact (CategoryTheory.cardinal_le_of_has_cardinal_lt hX).1
  apply Cardinal.regular_is_inaccessible
  exact κ.IsRegular.1
```
